text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world, but it also raises important ethical questions. One major concern is bias: AI systems can learn unfair patterns from the data they are trained on, leading to discrimination against certain groups. To achieve fairness, developers must carefully choose and review their data. Privacy is another key issue, as AI often collects and processes personal information without clear consent. Transparency requires that decisions made by AI are explainable and understandable to users. Ultimately, responsible AI development means creating systems that respect human rights, encourage accountability, and are designed with the public good in mind.
